recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD8 免疫染色可見大量棕色陽性小淋巴球，散佈於間質並排成小群或線狀排列（部分似沿血竇分佈），在脂肪與其他造血細胞之間相當醒目，支持 CD8 陽性 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病（T-LGL）的浸潤。
features: Increased CD8-positive small lymphocytes with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Interstitial distribution with small clusters and linear/cord-like arrays, some suggestive of intrasinusoidal location
Positive cells are small with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm; no large atypical cells
Interspersed CD8-negative hematopoietic cells and adipocytes in a normocellular to mildly hypocellular marrow
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD8 shows an increased population of small CD8-positive T lymphocytes distributed interstitially, forming small aggregates and linear arrays that in part suggest intrasinusoidal infiltration. The positive cells are small without cytologic atypia, and background hematopoietic elements are CD8 negative. The pattern is subtle on H&E and highlighted by immunohistochemistry; in conjunction with a peripheral LGL expansion and a clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement, findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive CD8+ T-cell expansion (viral infection, autoimmune disease, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates lack a persistent clonal TCR rearrangement and usually lack STAT3 mutation or intrasinusoidal linear clusters of TIA-1/granzyme B-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell proliferations are surface CD3 negative, CD56 positive and lack TCR gene rearrangement.
Shows a prominent sinusoidal infiltrate of medium-sized, usually CD4-/CD8- gamma-delta T cells with isochromosome 7q and aggressive clinical course.
Cells are larger and atypical, EBV positive, CD3-/CD56+, with fulminant clinical presentation.
